title: SensorPush Dome Climate Humidity Leaderboard
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensorpush:climate humidity_pct=*
| stats sum(humidity_pct) as total_value, avg(humidity_pct) as avg_value by dome_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks dome name values by total and average humidity across SensorPush dome climate events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `humidity_pct` values for each SensorPush dome climate event and review total and average humidity by dome name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total humidity.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which dome name shows the biggest humidity numbers in your SensorPush dome climate data.
